messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error signature: SIGSEGV + OOM in model-runner v2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/paging-oom

sam: oncall sam here, looking. what's current error rate?

anya: seeing spike to ~18% 5xx, top errors show SIGSEGV in quant-kernel and OOMs reported by model-runner on GPU nodes. Affected pools: model-runner-usw2-1/2.

sam: can we reroute to small-llm fallback? is routing override available?

anya: yes, we can override routing. I'll apply a 100% fallback to small-llm-v1 while we triage.

oliver: I'll also enable ingress backoff and temporary request-size reject for long contexts.

alex: CS: major customers (AcmeCorp, NovaLabs) reporting timeouts + failed generations. AcmeCorp ~40% failures in last 10m.

anya: applying routing override now:

anya: ```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"small-llm-v1","scope":"us-west-2"}'
```

incident-bot: routing override applied by anya at 1778889999 — success :white_check_mark:

miguel: scaling up dedicated pool: adding 4 nodes (g4dn.xlarge). kicking off ASG scale.

miguel: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-runner-usw2`

anya: draining runner-07, restarting model-runner process, collecting logs and core dumps.

alex: AcmeCorp update: they see improvement after fallback, but feature X still degraded. CS opening ticket and escalating to enterprise support.

priya: running quality evals on sample prompts vs small-llm-v1, will report top regressions.

oliver: error rate down to ~4% after routing override. Latency increased ~120ms but acceptable. No new OOMs on GPU nodes after drains.

sam: good. keep fallback for 30m, then canary back 10% if stable. who's owning postmortem?

anya: eng-runtime + eng-ml will own postmortem. I'll collect logs, core dumps, and kernel traces.

jordan: CS will draft customer impact summary for AcmeCorp & NovaLabs.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Timeline doc: https://redwood/incidents/1778889999

anya: starting canary at 10% now.

oliver: monitoring tracers and traces, no new segfaults.

priya: quality drop minimal for top 20 prompts, sending diff to product.

sam: update in 15m, thanks everyone.

anya: 30m update — error rate stabilized at 0.8%, rolling rollback routing to normal.

anya: routing rollback done. `kubectl rollout status deployment/model-runner-usw2` shows healthy.

sam: closing pager in 10m if no regressions. postmortem assigned to eng-runtime/eng-ml; interim actions: increase kvcache guard, add OOM cgroup limits, improve core dump collection, add routing fast-fail config.

alex: CS will follow up with affected customers and notes for SLA reconciliation.

sam: thanks. :thumbsup:
